# Regulator

Source: [`Kernel/Regulator.wl`](../../Kernel/Regulator.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#regulator-kernelregulatorwl--defineregulator)

DefineRegulator: the regulator R\_k as Gamma2-level entries per field pair, and its derivative d\_s R (s = ln k) by the chain rule, with abstract shape functions r(y), y = q^2/k^2. Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Regulator".

## Symbols

### `DefineRegulator`

`DefineRegulator[ansatz, {a, b} -> R_ab, ..., "Shapes" -> {r1, r2, ...}]` declares the regulator per field pair. R\_ab is the Gamma2-level entry (what adds to Gamma2\_ab, including the factor 2 of a diagonal pair), written with the loop momentum q and the RG scale k, shapes as `r[q^2/k^2]`, e.g. {Hbar, H} -> nk q^2 `arnh[q^2/k^2]`. Returns the "Regulator" stage.

### `dsCoupling`

`dsCoupling[c]` = k dc/dk, the scale derivative of the coupling c (becomes -eta c downstream).

### `dsR`

`dsR[a, b]` is the abstract entry (a, b) of d\_s R (fields in field order); it is replaced by the derived d\_s R at assembly. Map to DE4plus\_fast.wl: dsNh = `dsR[H, Hbar]`, dsMh = `dsR[Hbar, Hbar]`, dsNphi = `dsR[Psi, Psibar]`, dsMphi = `dsR[Psibar, Psibar]`.

### `RegulatorMatrix`

`RegulatorMatrix[regulator, s]` is the matrix R\_ab at q^2 = s, in field order.

### `DsRegulatorMatrix`

`DsRegulatorMatrix[regulator, s]` is the derived matrix d\_s R\_ab at q^2 = s (`dsCoupling[c]` symbols, shape derivatives).

### `DsRAbstractMatrix`

`DsRAbstractMatrix[regulator]` is the matrix of abstract symbols `dsR[a, b]` (0 where R\_ab = 0).

### `DsRRules`

`DsRRules[regulator, s]` are the rules `dsR[a, b]` -> derived d\_s R\_ab at q^2 = s.

### `ShowRegulator`

`ShowRegulator[regulator]` prints R\_ab and d\_s R\_ab.
